extracted.intended_audience: readers of classic Renaissance satire; general literary readers
extracted.subtask_description: An excerpt from Rabelais' Gargantua and Pantagruel (Book 4) — comic, grotesque, episodic Renaissance prose mixing satire, mythological allusion, and bawdy description. The page contains narrative episodes, character sketches, and fanciful anatomical/comic catalogues rather than evaluative criteria.
